title: PhysicsDirectSpaceState2D.intersect_point() doesn't work if PhysicsBody2D is parented to CanvasLayer
body:
### Tested versions

Found in v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6]

### System information

Windows 10 - Godot 4.4.1 - all renderers

### Issue description

When trying to intersect a point query with Area2Ds or StaticBody2Ds, it only work when they're not parented to a CanvasLayer. I expect this to work because there is no problem when I use a ray.

### Steps to reproduce

1) Create a scene with Area2Ds and/or StaticBody2Ds

2) Set them to children (directly or indirectly) of a CanvasLayer.

3) Try to use the following code:

```
func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	var space := get_world_2d().direct_space_state

	var point_query := PhysicsPointQueryParameters2D.new()
	point_query.collide_with_areas = true
	point_query.collide_with_bodies = true
	
	var mouse_pos := get_viewport().get_mouse_position()
	
	point_query.position = mouse_pos

	var point_res := space.intersect_point(point_query)

	print("point_res:", point_res)
```

4) Notice that point_res will always be empty.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[physics_point2d_bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19618095/physics_point2d_bug.zip)
